localData.title: Data on this device
localData.note: Your PDF files stay where they are. {{app}} keeps only settings, the light or dark theme, accent colour and density, your reviewer profile, comment tool defaults and saved comment styles, saved visual signatures, custom status schemes, table templates, the recent files list and recovery snapshots of unsaved changes. Storage used includes the offline copy of the app.
localData.confirmDescription: This deletes your settings, theme, accent colour and density (back to light, blue and comfortable), reviewer profile, comment tool defaults and saved comment styles, saved visual signatures, custom status schemes, table templates, the recent files list and all recovery snapshots on this device. Your PDF files are not changed. The offline copy of the app is kept, so {{app}} keeps working offline.

lineUp.buttonTip: Line up this sheet by hand: click the same point on the old and the new drawing
lineUp.title: Line up sheet {{sheet}}
lineUp.steps: Steps to line up the sheet
lineUp.step_2: Same point on the new drawing
lineUp.say_1: Find a point you can see on both drawings, such as a grid crossing or a corner. Click it on the old drawing (Document A, outlined).
lineUp.say_2: Now click the same point on the new drawing (Document B, outlined).
lineUp.say_2more: Click the same point on the new drawing (Document B, outlined).
lineUp.say_3: The overlay now follows your point. If the sheet is also scaled or turned, click a second point far from the first on the old drawing. Otherwise choose Apply.
lineUp.say_4: Check the overlay: when the lines sit on top of each other, choose Apply. A third pair of points gives a best fit.
lineUp.say_full: Three pairs of points picked. Check the overlay, then choose Apply.
lineUp.say_paused: Picking is paused. Choose Pick points to go on, or open Fine-tune in the Alignment section to type the values.
lineUp.snap: Points snap to the drawing; hold Alt not to snap.
lineUp.here_a: Click the point here, on the old drawing
lineUp.here_b: Click the same point here, on the new drawing
lineUp.paneHint: Follow the steps above the drawings. The points you pick:
lineUp.banner: This sheet may not be lined up correctly.
lineUp.bannerMore: Look at the overlay. If lines show twice, line the sheet up by hand; if it looks right, say so.

tips.colours_text: Lines only in the old drawing are red, lines only in the new drawing are green, and lines in both are black. The key follows the colours you choose.
tips.differences_text: The Differences pane lists each change. Click one to go to it, and tick it when you have checked it.
tips.lineUp_text: If the two drawings do not sit on top of each other, choose Line up and click the same point on both drawings.
